The opportunity
Join our Grid Quality team as a Power System Simulation Model Engineer and help shape the future of sustainable energy. Work on cutting-edge solutions that strengthen grids, enable renewable integration, and accelerate the energy transition—perfect for fresh graduates in Electrical, Power, or Energy Engineering.
How you’ll make an impact
Develop, implement, validate, and deliver simulation models to our customers in tenders and projects using various power system tools to support grid optimization and renewable integration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including our R&D, and customers, to gather requirements to support the design of effective technical solutions.
Create software in the loop model of real-time control functions
Perform testing and validation of power system models and associated tools.
Perform RMS simulation studies with customer networks
Prepare clear and structured technical documentation and reports.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in power system modeling.
Contribute to knowledge sharing by supporting, training, and collaborating with colleagues throughout project execution.

Your Background
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with at least three years of experience in power system analysis.
Knowledge of, or experience with, power system simulation tools such as RTDS, PSCAD, PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, MATLAB and EMTP.
Interest in or experience with programming (e.g., C++, C#, FORTRAN, DSL, Python, MATLAB), control theory, signal processing, and dynamic modelling.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve complex problems.
Proficiency in English is required; knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

Are you an experienced Software Engineer with a background in software development and cloud technologies? We are looking for experienced developers to join our team at ICT Additude and work as consultants in assignments with our clients in Skåne.
🌟 The role
As a Software Engineer at ICT Additude, you will work as a consultant in assignments that vary depending on the client, project, and your experience. You may work with designing and developing backend systems, APIs, cloud-based solutions, integrations, databases, or system architecture.
We are also seeing AI becoming an increasingly important part of software development and our clients' technical environments. Therefore, we are particularly interested in developers who have experience working with AI technologies or who have used AI as part of their development work.
🔍⚙️ We are looking for someone with experience in

System Design & Architecture: Designing and developing stable backend systems with a focus on business logic, maintainability, and scalability.

Cloud Solutions: Working with Azure, AWS, or GCP and building or maintaining cloud-based applications.

API Development: Developing APIs and integrating systems and external services.

Database Management: Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Security & Performance: Building secure systems and working with performance optimization.

AI: Practical experience using AI technologies, services, or tools as part of software development.

🎯 The Ideal Candidate
We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and working in different environments. As a consultant, you are comfortable collaborating with different teams and stakeholders and adapting to different technical contexts and client needs.
You are also curious about developments within AI and have an interest in how AI can be used in software development and technical solutions.
👉 Requirements

University degree within the IT field.

Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development using languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, Go, C#, or Node.js.

Experience in API development and database management (SQL and NoSQL).

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Experience working with security and authentication, such as OAuth.

Experience or practical knowledge of AI technologies and tools.

Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Willingness to work on-site with clients in Skåne and occasionally travel within the region.

🌈 Bonus Points

Experience integrating AI services or LLMs into applications.

Experience with technologies or concepts such as RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents.

Experience with machine learning models.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with microservice or serverless architecture.

Knowledge of messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

🌍 Why ICT Additude?
At ICT Additude, you’ll be part of an experienced team of consultants working within software and technology. We value knowledge-sharing and offer continuous development through regular dev-talks with your manager.
Your employment is covered by a collective agreement and includes benefits such as 30 days of holiday, ITP1 pension, a 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, and the option of a benefit bike or car.
Based in Malmö/Lund, we are part of ICT Group, a European technology group working within software, technology, and product development.
Please note that we are looking for colleagues already located in Sweden, and we will only consider applications submitted through our ATS.

In this role as Application Engineer, you will be part of the Engineering team for on-load tap-changers working on product care and product upgrades. Are you interested in working with technically challenging products in an international environment? Experienced professionals or fresh out of university – we are interested in all kinds of people

Build the bridge from innovation to industrial scale
Smart High Tech is transforming breakthrough graphene technology into an industrial reality.
Our advanced thermal management materials enable the next generation of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, data centres and high-performance electronics.
As we move from R&D and qualification to large-scale production, we are looking for a Production Engineer to play a key role in industrialising our products and building robust manufacturing processes for future growth.
Your Mission
You will act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production, ensuring our products can be manufactured efficiently, consistently and at scale.
Your mission is to:

Industrialise new products and processes.

Establish robust manufacturing methods.

Improve yield, efficiency and process capability.

Support production scale-up and operational excellence.

This role directly impacts our ability to qualify with customers, expand production capacity and achieve commercial success.
What You Will DoIndustrialisation & NPI
Support the introduction of new products into production.

Act as the technical interface between R&D and Production.

Participate in design reviews with a Design for Manufacturability (DFM) perspective.

Coordinate validation, qualification and production readiness activities.

Process & Production Development
Develop and optimise manufacturing processes.

Define process parameters, work instructions and SOPs.

Support the implementation of production equipment and tooling.

Ensure successful transfer of processes into operations.

Data, Systems & Traceability
Support data collection, traceability and process monitoring.

Define requirements for MES and production systems.

Ensure systems support continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement
Analyse process performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Reduce scrap, cycle time and process variation.

Apply Lean principles and structured problem-solving methodologies.

Support sustainable operational improvements.

Equipment & Technical Ownership
Participate in equipment selection and implementation.

Support FAT and SAT activities.

Manage engineering changes and technical improvements.

Collaborate with Maintenance to ensure equipment reliability.

Key Interfaces
You will work closely with:

Production & Operations

R&D

Quality & Planning

Maintenance & Facility

External suppliers and partners

Who You Are
You combine strong engineering skills with a hands-on mindset and a passion for building efficient production systems.
You enjoy solving technical challenges, improving processes and working across functions to drive results.
QualificationsRequired
Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing or Production Engineering.

Experience in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Industrialisation.

Experience supporting new product introductions and process development.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments.

Experience with process validation, documentation and continuous improvement.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials, battery or other high-tech manufacturing industries.

Experience with MES, automation and data-driven manufacturing.

Knowledge of FAT, SAT and engineering change management.

Experience from scale-up or fast-growing manufacturing environments.

Swedish and/or Mandarin language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
This is a role for someone who wants to build, not maintain.
You will help transform world-leading technology into industrial-scale production while working alongside leading scientists, engineers and industry experts.
Your work will directly influence how future AI infrastructure and advanced electronics are manufactured.
What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Successfully industrialised new products.

Established scalable and robust manufacturing processes.

Improved yield, throughput and process capability.

Contributed to the next phase of Smart High Tech's industrial growth.

The Opportunity
We strive to be world leaders in electric power by helping countries to have greener, stronger and cleaner electricity. By bringing sustainable energy to more and more people, we can reduce our impact on the planet. When you work with us, you will be part of a higher purpose where each department contributes. Together we can encourage the next innovation - to make life better for everyone.
The Global SCM organization delivers value and service to HVDC’s large infrastructure projects around the world. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing large SCM projects close to the end customer by applying to the following role! 
In the role as Tender SCM you work individually and will be responsible for SCM scope in the Tender Core Team, with a key role interacting with HVDC stakeholders in tender execution. You will be based in Ludvika where the rest of the team in Sweden is located.
How you’ll make an impact
You will be on the driving seat for any needs or issues related to supply chain, engaging other departments (engineering, documentation, finance, etc.) for your input.
Perform cost calculation on the material, resources, and other costs related to SCM scope.
Provide feedback to tender team related to time schedule, terms & conditions, payment milestones, customer requirements.
Perform risk assessment from SCM perspective.
Connect with SCM Category Managers and the suppliers, for at least but not limited to, request for Quotation (RFQ), negotiation, discussing special customer requirements.
Be the SCM representative in the tender core team.
Contribute to strategic work, lessons learned, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to tender meetings as well as in review meetings.
In collaboration with Category Management, keep updated on market developments in pricing and deliveries.

Your background 
Preferably you have some years of relevant working experience, so you feel comfortable in taking decisions, questioning and take full responsibility for outcome of the work in your project by the SCM organization.
You are a team player with strong communicative and collaborative skills, and you are comfortable with thinking outside of the box.
We think that you are an energetic, endurant, responsible, and independent person with great structure skills. You are curious and open to changes, value integrity, get things done in a timely manner, and always drive for efficiency.

Xensam: Join the Future of SAM Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
Together, we build the future of SAM. 
About the role
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the success and satisfaction of our enterprise clients. You will work closely with them to understand their business needs, implement effective strategies, and provide ongoing support to ensure they achieve their desired outcomes. Your goal is to foster strong, long-term relationships and drive customer retention and growth.
Responsibilities

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building trusted advisor relationships.

Conduct regular check-ins and Business Reviews to ensure customers are satisfied and achieving their goals.

Lead the onboarding process for new enterprise customers, ensuring a smooth transition and successful implementation of our products/services.

Address and resolve customer concerns promptly, escalating issues when necessary.

Renew accounts to enhance customer retention with timely management.

Gather feedback through surveys and product usage data, identifying trends to share with internal teams.

Represent customers’ needs and success stories to drive customer-centric improvements across the company.

Keep educational, power points and self-service resources up-to-date.

Anticipate customer needs by analyzing usage patterns, engagement metrics, and feedback.

Manage and update customer information in the CRM system, ensuring data accuracy and tracking all customer interactions. Use the CRM to monitor customer health, manage tasks, and maintain a clear view of the customer lifecycle.

Qualifications 

5+ years of experience working B2B as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Key Account Manager or Senior Customer Success Manager.

Experience with support tools and platforms like HubSpot.

Excellent presentation and organizational skills.

An innovative self leader that is service minded.

Proficiency in languages like German, and Dutch is a plus.

Experience in the field of SaaS is a requirement.

Fluency in both written and spoken English and Swedish.

What you get

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.

Other location-specific benefits.

Our values at Xensam
Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.

Looking for your next challenge as a Senior DevOps Engineer in the automotive industry? Keep reading! ALTEN Sweden is currently seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with experience in CI/CD, automation, cloud technologies, and containerized environments. This role is for one of our key clients in the automotive sector in Gothenburg.
You will join a highly skilled engineering environment where you will take ownership of pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployment strategies that support next-generation automotive platforms.
What we offer
Challenging and innovative assignments with leading automotive clients.
A strong engineering culture with collaborative international teams.
Supportive leadership focused on personal growth and development.
A personal training budget for internal or external courses.
Opportunities to explore different technical domains and industries within ALTEN.

About the role 
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing automated CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure for large-scale automotive systems.
You will work closely with development, architecture, and platform teams, driving best practices in automation, scalability, security, and cloud-native deployments.
Your main responsibilities include:
Designing, building, and maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Groovy.
Developing automation and tools using Python.
Driving containerization strategies using Docker and modern container frameworks.
Building and managing cloud infrastructure using Azure and Terraform (IaC).
Managing Azure services such as ACR, networking, security, and Key Vault.
Improving platform performance, observability, monitoring, and system reliability.
Taking ownership of DevOps practices within cross-functional Scrum teams.
Supporting developers and teams to ensure frictionless, secure, and scalable deployments.
Leading continuous improvements within DevOps workflows and cloud infrastructure.

Who you are
We are looking for a senior professional with strong technical foundations, deep hands-on experience, and a proactive mindset.
You take initiative, solve complex problems independently, and enjoy mentoring others when needed.
Your profile:
5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud DevOps, or Platform Engineering roles.
Extensive experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines with Groovy.
Strong experience with Docker and containerization workflows.
Solid hands-on knowledge of Terraform and IaC principles.
Strong cloud experience with Azure (ACR, networking, security, Key Vault, container services).
Proficiency in Python for automation and scripting.
Previous experience in Agile/Scrum and cross-functional engineering teams.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

It’s a plus if you have:
Experience with Azure Container Apps or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of Kubernetes or GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux).
Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Azure Monitor.
Background in large-scale enterprise or automotive environments.
Strong understanding of cloud security and governance models.
Experience mentoring or guiding junior engineers.

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.
Welcome to read more about us atalten.se

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

What you will do
As an Aftermarket Methods Engineer, you will play an important role in ensuring our products can be serviced efficiently, safely, and sustainably throughout their lifecycle. You will develop and maintain service and repair methods for Volvo Construction Equipment products, with a primary focus on wheel loaders and powertrain components. 
 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Developing and improving service and repair methods and instructions for aftermarket operations. 
Supporting product development projects with serviceability expertise. 
Planning and executing service procedure development and time studies. 
Designing and validating special tools and workshop solutions. 
Collaborating with technical writers to ensure accurate and high-quality service documentation. 
Driving new ways of working by exploring and implementing digital technologies such as AI, VR, and other innovative solutions. 
Working closely with design engineers, product specialists, and other stakeholders across Volvo CE. 

 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how future products are maintained and serviced while contributing to an improved customer experience worldwide.
Who are we?
Methods Engineering Wheel Loader and Powertrain is part of Aftermarket Service Technology within Volvo Construction Equipment. We are a team of approximately 20 skilled and engaged colleagues based in Eskilstuna. 

Our mission is to develop service methods, technical documentation, spare parts solutions, and serviceability improvements for wheel loaders, axles, transmissions, and engines. We combine technical expertise with a strong customer focus to deliver solutions that support uptime, safety, and sustainability.
Who are you?
We believe you are a curious and solution-oriented person who enjoys combining technical expertise with practical applications. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are motivated by continuous improvement and innovation. 
 
To be successful in this role, you likely have: 
Hands-on experience working with heavy vehicles, construction equipment, or similar products. 
A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience. 
Strong technical understanding and an interest in developing efficient service solutions. 
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. 
A structured and analytical way of working. 
A valid driver's license (B). 

 
It is considered a merit if you also have experience with: 
CAD and/or PDM systems. 
Hydraulics, electrical and electronic systems. 
Engines, transmissions, or driveline components. 
Service development, workshop operations, or technical documentation. 

 
We know that no one checks every box. If you are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every qualification listed.
What’s in it for you?
At Volvo Construction Equipment, you will be part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and sustainability drive everything we do. We offer an environment where you can develop both professionally and personally while working with technologies that shape the future of our industry. 
 
You will join a diverse and supportive team where different perspectives are valued and where your ideas can make a real impact. Together, we create solutions that help our customers succeed and contribute to a more sustainable world. 
Ready for the next move?
If you are interested in joining us and helping shape the future of aftermarket service solutions, we look forward to receiving your application.

The opportunity
We are looking for a Customer Support Manager to join Hitachi Energy’s Capacitors business in Ludvika, Sweden. As our business grows, we are establishing a new Customer Support and Export function to strengthen customer focus and create clear ownership from order receipt through delivery and after-sales support.
In this role, you will build and shape the new function, bringing together order handling, customer support, warranty and claims management, and export activities. You will develop the team, establish processes and ways of working, and collaborate across the business to deliver a professional and responsive customer experience.
How you’ll make an impact
Build, lead, and develop the Customer Support and Export team, establishing clear roles, responsibilities, and ways of working.
Oversee order handling for capacitor units, loose units, spare parts, and other assigned orders, ensuring accurate processing, clear customer communication, and effective follow-up from receipt through delivery.
Lead customer support, warranty, and claims management, ensuring timely prioritization, escalation, and resolution of customer cases.
Manage export activities, including shipping coordination, logistics, customs, and export documentation.
Ensure effective coordination and handovers with Sales, Project Management, Planning, Operations, and Supply Chain.
Drive continuous improvement through customer feedback, performance indicators, and structured follow-up.
Lead by example in health, safety, integrity, and compliance.

Your background
A university degree in engineering, business administration, supply chain, project management, or a related field.
Leadership experience in order management, customer support, project management, after-sales, supply chain, logistics, export, or industrial operations.
Experience developing processes and ways of working, with a good understanding of order-to-delivery flows in an industrial or project-driven environment.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, combined with a structured, customer-focused approach and a commitment to developing people.
Experience with customer issues, warranties, or claims and an international manufacturing or project environment is an advantage.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage.

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a proactive and business-oriented AI Adoption Epic Owner / Project Lead to drive the adoption of AI-powered solutions across engineering and software development teams.
The organisation has developed an AI platform that enables automated workflows for embedded software development. The next step is to scale its adoption across engineering activities, including testing, verification, fault-trace analysis and code reviews.

Drive AI adoption initiatives across engineering and software development teams.
Act as Epic Owner and coordinate planning, execution and follow-up of AI initiatives.
Contribute to product roadmaps, epic planning and backlog management.

Support adoption of AI-powered automation in testing, verification, fault-trace analysis and code reviews.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner and development organisation.

Monitor progress and ensure initiatives deliver measurable business value.
Work in an agile environment and continuously improve adoption processes.
Identify opportunities to scale AI capabilities across engineering teams.

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
Experience as an Agile Epic Owner, Product Manager, Product Owner or in a similar agile leadership role.
Strong backlog management and prioritisation skills.
Good business understanding and ability to connect technology initiatives with business objectives.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to navigate complex organisations and independently drive initiatives.

Meritorious Experience
Previous experience in embedded software development.
Familiarity with automotive software development.
Understanding of automotive system engineering and engineering workflows.
Experience driving AI adoption or digital transformation initiatives.
Knowledge of AI applications in software testing, verification and code analysis.
Experience working with agile development teams and technical roadmaps.

Personal Competencies
We are looking for someone who is:
Curious about emerging technologies and practical AI applications.
Proactive, structured and comfortable taking ownership.

An excellent communicator who builds relationships across teams.

Focused on turning technical opportunities into measurable results.

jobs.occupation: Lärare i textilslöjd samt bild till Paradisskolan
jobs.description:
Vi är stolta över Trollhättans stads över 5 000 medarbetare, som varje dag gör en positiv skillnad i våra invånares liv och är med och utvecklar stadens hållbarhet och livskraft. Vi drivs och motiveras av ledorden Mod, Delaktighet, Nytänkande och Handlingskraft. Här finns en spännande utveckling där du kan vara med och göra vår stad ännu bättre.
Är du en engagerad och kunnig slöjd- bildlärare som vill inspirera och utmana våra elever? Vill du arbeta i en skola där trygghet, studiero och lärande står i fokus, och där vi tillsammans skapar möjligheter för varje elev? Då kan Paradisskolan vara rätt arbetsplats för dig!
Vi söker en legitimerad och behörig lärare för undervisning i årskurs 3–9. Du blir del av ett engagerat och kompetent kollegium, med nära tillgång till elevhälsoteamet som arbetar nära undervisningen och verksamheten.
Om Paradisskolan
Paradisskolan är centralt belägen i Källstorp i västra Trollhättan och har cirka 400 elever i årskurs 4–9. Vår elevgrupp präglas av mångfald, vilket berikar både undervisning och skolmiljö.
På skolan finns även English Speaking Class (ESC) där undervisning i NO och SO bedrivs på engelska. Vi tar emot elever från hela Trollhättan och från olika delar av världen, vilket bidrar till en internationell och levande skolmiljö.
Vårt utvecklingsarbete fokuserar på undervisningens kvalitet och en trygg miljö för lärande. Vi arbetar utifrån visionen:
”Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden genom form, förutsättningar och förväntan.”
Vi tror på att:
Alla vill lyckas
Framgång skapas gemensamt
Vi möter varandra med nyfikenhet, respekt och omtanke
Vi prövar olika metoder för att varje elev ska nå sitt bästa jag

Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i slöjd/bild. Du har en djup och uppdaterad ämneskunskap inom ämnena och kan förmedla hantverkets möjligheter på ett inspirerande och kreativt sätt. Genom varierad, praktisk och kreativ undervisning skapar du nyfikenhet, lust att skapa och hjälper eleverna att utveckla sina förmågor – både hantverksmässigt, problemlösande och personligt.
Du har ett relationellt ledarskap där du bygger trygga, respektfulla och professionella relationer med eleverna. Du leder undervisningen med tydlighet, värme och struktur och du möter elevernas olika behov och erfarenheter med flexibilitet, tålamod och engagemang. Du arbetar aktivt för att skapa studiero, positiv motivation och arbetsglädje och du fungerar som en stabil och positiv förebild i både vardag och undervisning.
Vidare ser vi att du:
skapar goda relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
har förmåga att anpassa undervisningen efter elevernas olika förutsättningar
har goda IKT-kunskaper och använder digitala verktyg i slöjdens planering och dokumentation
har trygghet i styrdokumenten och kan omsätta dem i praktiken
deltar i kollegialt lärande och bidrar aktivt till skolans utvecklingsarbete
möter eleverna med höga förväntningar, nyfikenhet och respekt

Vi söker i första hand en behörig och legitimerad slöjdlärare, men vi är öppna för alla sökande med relevant kompetens, hantverkserfarenhet och ett tydligt engagemang för elevernas lärande och utveckling.
Anställningsinformation
Utdrag ur Belastningsregistret är obligatoriskt vid arbete med barn.
Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.
Tjänsten är en visstid med möjlighet till förlängning.
Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons!
Trollhättan är en stark och attraktiv kommun som ska bli större. I dag är vi ca 59 000 invånare och vi har siktet inställt på att växa till 70 000 trollhättebor. Inom Trollhättans stad arbetar vi med att skapa förutsättningar för detta. Vi är över 5 000 medarbetare och våra 350 olika yrken bidrar på olika sätt med att ge service och underlätta en bra vardag för våra invånare - nu och i framtiden. Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund.
Trollhättans stad tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

An international organisation is looking for a consultant to strengthen Compensation & Benefits (C&B) governance across its R&D operations and bring C&B expertise to organisational design and job grading projects.
The consultant will assess how organisational decisions affect employment conditions, pay and benefits across countries. They will identify where local practices can be aligned and propose common principles or measures to manage differences where local arrangements need to remain in place.
Key responsibilities

Lead the R&D C&B portfolio by setting priorities, clarifying ownership, tracking actions and reporting progress to management.

Represent R&D HR in strategic C&B forums and coordinate with central HR, business units and service providers.

Lead preparations for EU pay transparency requirements in Sweden and Germany, including local delivery models, data needs, roles and coordination with providers.

Support the design and rollout of FY2027 compensation and incentive structures through analysis, recommendations and stakeholder coordination.

Map salary structures, incentives, benefits, employment conditions, processes and the annual C&B cycle across R&D locations.

Assess how local practices align with the shared job architecture and grading framework. Explain the business implications of material differences and develop options and recommendations for decision-makers.

Clarify how C&B services are delivered, including service-level agreements, provider expectations, data and benchmarking requests, ownership and handover documentation.

Advise on organisational design and grading projects that affect related HR processes.

Occasional travel between Sweden and Germany.

Required qualifications

University degree or equivalent education in HR, business administration, economics or a related field.

Several years of experience in Compensation & Benefits and organisational design in an international organisation, with a strong understanding of how job evaluation and grading affect compensation and benefits.

Solid knowledge of grading methods, fixed and variable pay, bonus and incentive eligibility, benefits and salary bands.

Experience working with HR Business Partners, service providers and central functions in a matrix organisation.

Strong analytical, strategic and project management skills.

Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn complex information into clear material for decision-makers.

English proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA.

Additional training in Compensation & Benefits or change management, for example through WorldatWork.

Certification in a recognised job grading methodology.

Knowledge of German collective agreements and Swedish compensation practices.

Experience designing or implementing job architecture, including job families, levels and career paths.

Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or a comparable HR system.

Experience in a multi-brand, automotive or industrial organisation.

German, Swedish or Portuguese language skills.

Working style
You can take ownership of ongoing work quickly, make sense of complex or partly documented issues and deliver accurate recommendations with limited guidance. You communicate clearly, adapt to your audience and build trust across functions and cultures. You are diplomatic when interests differ and confident in moving decisions forward, even when information is incomplete.

Verified started with solutions for electronic signatures, identification and contract management. Working closely with our customers, we have since built digital flows for anti-money laundering (AML/KYC) and supplier assessments, including through the acquisition of GRC Watch in 2024. Today Verified is a RegTech company that helps businesses work securely, efficiently and in line with regulation.
We are around 100 people focused on the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. At Verified, everyone helps build the company's future and takes responsibility for what we promise and deliver, both internally and to our customers.
About the role and the team
As Senior Product Manager you will have end-to-end ownership of one or more of Verified's products, from vision and strategy to launch and continuous improvement. You will work in a small, cross-functional team, close to both customers and developers, where your decisions quickly show in the product and the business.
In the role you will, among other things:

Shape and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap, linked to Verified's business goals.

Meet customers and users regularly to understand their needs and turn insights into product decisions.

Prioritise based on short- and long-term business value and own the product backlog.

Work hands-on with the team: write requirements, test ideas quickly and follow up on impact after launch.

Work closely with Sales, Support, Solution Management and other product teams, for example in customer conversations and demos.

Make sure legal and regulatory requirements are handled in product development.

Use AI both in the product and to improve how we work.

About you
We would like you to have

At least five years of experience in product management, some of it in a SaaS, fintech or scale-up company.

Experience of shaping a product vision yourself and driving it to measurable results.

Experience with B2B products and of working directly with customers and a sales organisation.

An interest in regulatory topics and an understanding of the compliance challenges businesses face.

Hands-on experience with AI, both in products and in your own way of working.

Excellent Swedish and English.

It is a plus if you have

A background in finance, fintech or another regulated industry.

Knowledge of regulations such as AML, DORA, NIS2 or eIDAS.

Experience with products that have network effects, or platforms.

Experience with products in e-signing, digital identity or KYC.

Personal qualities
You are driven by building products that customers actually use and pay for. You are curious, take ownership and get things done, even when not all structures and resources are in place.
You thrive where priorities can change quickly, and you would rather make a well-founded decision today than a perfect one in three months. You enjoy switching between strategic work, customer dialogue and close collaboration with the team.
What we offer
At Verified you will have real influence over both our products and how we work. Our culture is built on engagement, collaboration and community.

30 days of vacation and five compensation days

Wellness allowance, occupational pension and a benefit bike

Shared breakfasts, social activities and moving days

Hybrid model with at least two days a week at our Stockholm office

Practical information
Start: by agreement

Scope: full-time

Process: an initial call, interviews with Verified, personality and logic tests, and a case. References and a background check at a later stage.

Plan, execute, and follow up on international trade shows, hosted events, webinars, and regional marketing activities

Research and evaluate new event opportunities and develop concepts across our key markets

Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Business Development to promote events, drive registrations and secure meetings with customers and prospects

Ensure effective lead follow-up in collaboration with Sales and Business Development

Track and analyze event performance, including MQLs, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline contribution

Capture photos, short videos, and event highlights to support marketing activities

Continuously improve event performance and ways of working through data, insights, and AI tools

At least 3 years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or a similar role, preferably within B2B

Experience managing event budgets, vendors, and external stakeholders

Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

A commercial mindset and an understanding of how events contribute to pipeline generation and business growth

Structured, proactive, and able to take ownership in a fast-paced environment

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.

Other location-specific benefits.

Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.
